name: Grelin Whitebeard
summary: In Coldridge Valley, Grelin Whitebeard keeps watch over the Frostmane threat by royal decree. Ironforge is busy fighting troggs, so his isolated camp depends on local recruits.

sections.title: A Royal Mandate
sections.body: Grelin Whitebeard and his brother Senir came to Coldridge Valley under orders from the Senate of Ironforge and King Magni Bronzebeard. Their charge was to assess and quell the threat from the native Frostmane trolls. Ironforge's soldiers are busy fighting trogg outbreaks across Dun Morogh, leaving the brothers short of supplies. So Grelin made camp in the snowy hills and relies on local recruits and passing initiates to do the work.

sections.title: Trouble in the South
sections.body:
From his camp, Grelin watches the Frostmane tribe press south from Coldridge Valley. The trolls grow bolder and raid beyond their mountain caverns. During one raid, Grik'nir the Cold, a heavily painted troll, slipped into the unattended camp and stole Grelin's field journal of observations.

Grelin will not fail the King. He sends travelers into the Frostmane caves to recover his writings and carry his final report to Senir in Kharanos.

faq.q: Why is Grelin Whitebeard out here in the snow?
faq.answer: The Senate of Ironforge and King Magni Bronzebeard sent Grelin to assess and quell the Frostmane threat in Coldridge Valley. With Ironforge's soldiers busy fighting troggs elsewhere, he relies on local recruits.
A Frostmane troll named Grik'nir the Cold stole Grelin's journal during a raid on his unattended camp. Grelin saw the heavily marked brute flee toward the southern troll caves with his field notes.
Grelin's brother is Senir Whitebeard, stationed in Kharanos farther down the mountain. Grelin sends trusted runners there with reports on troll movements.

faq.q: Who is with Grelin at his camp?
faq.answer: No companions are recorded at Grelin's camp. Grelin and Senir were sent to face the trolls with little help, and the camp was unattended when the trolls raided it.

faq.q: Why doesn't Ironforge send regular soldiers to help him?
faq.answer: Ironforge's defenders and Senate forces are busy with trogg infestations across Dun Morogh. Scouts like Grelin rely on local recruits to face regional threats.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you see Grelin serving King Magni and guarding Dun Morogh's borders against threats within Ironforge's reach.
As a gnome newly arrived from Gnomeregan's tragedy, you may find Grelin glad for any capable hand against the Frostmane.
As an Alliance member, you see how thin Alliance and Ironforge forces are stretched across Dun Morogh. Scouts like Grelin face the trolls with little help.
